title: cross-functional-roadmap-sync-prep-may-2026-raj-personal-notes
content:
Meeting: Cross-functional roadmap alignment (Product + Eng + Applied ML)
Date/time: 2026-05-13 10:00am PT (30m) — aim for focused decisions
Location: Zoom / eng-roadmap Slack thread
Attendees (requested): Maya (PM), Asha (Applied ML), John (Serving Runtime), Priya (SRE), me (Raj - Platform)

Goals for this sync:
- Align on top 3 roadmap priorities for next 6 weeks that affect serving/runtime and model onboarding.
- Identify hard dependencies and capacity risks (infra, data, evals).
- Agree owners and minimal acceptance criteria for canary rollouts and metrics to track.

Pre-read (please skim before meeting):
- Q2 roadmap draft (Confluence) -> linked above
- PROG-412: feature gating for streaming + function-calls (JIRA-PROD-412)
- PLAT-98: autoscale policy changes and dedicated capacity plan (JIRA-PLAT-98)
- PR #142: serving runtime kernel selection change (github link)

Agenda (tight):
1) Quick context + constraints (5m) — me
   - Infra capacity: committed dedicated nodes + expected burst budget (Priya to confirm)
   - Major customer commitments (enterprise pilot timelines)
2) Priorities (10m) — Maya leads
   - Streaming + function-calls rollout: what must land in runtime vs product?
   - Model onboarding / quantization recommendations (Asha)
   - Autoscale policy updates and SLO implications (John/Priya)
3) Risks & blockers (8m) — quick callouts
   - Eval regressions on LlamaX-30B quantized (Asha)
   - Kernel perf variance across sequence lengths after PR #142 (John)
   - Dedicated cluster headroom for enterprise pilot (Priya)
4) Decisions & action items (7m) — capture owners and due dates

Key context notes (my scratchpad):
- Customer pilot (AcmeHealth) wants streaming + tool-calls in June. If we miss, likely delay of 4–6 weeks. Product asked for preview canary by 2026-06-01.
- Asha's eval shows ~5% generation quality delta at 4-bit quant on LlamaX-30B for complex instructions (see linked eval sheet in Confluence). Need to decide if acceptable or require fallback to FP16 for selected prompts.
- Autoscale change (PLAT-98) could increase latency for cold-starts slightly but reduces cost by 18% — tradeoff needs clear SLO acceptance.

Open questions to raise:
- What is the minimal feature set for Beta streaming (e.g., partial tool-call semantics) vs full function-calls? (Impacts runtime + SDK)
- If we restrict quantized models for Beta to a small prompt set, can product commit to those guardrails in docs/SDK?
- Can SRE guarantee N-1 capacity for dedicated clusters during canary weeks? (Priya to confirm capacity numbers)

Proposed decisions to push in meeting (so we have output):
- Decision A: Accept streaming Beta with limited function-call support (no nested tool-chains) and explicit prompt guardrails. Owner: Maya. Due: 2026-05-20.
- Decision B: For LlamaX-30B, use 4-bit quant in prod only for non-critical prompts; fallback to FP16 for eval failing prompts. Owner: Asha. Deliverable: prompt list and eval pass criteria by 2026-05-22.
- Decision C: Apply autoscale policy PLAT-98 to staging canary next week; collect p50/p95 latency and cold-start metrics for 2 weeks before prod flip. Owner: John + Priya. Start: 2026-05-17.

Draft action items (my notes, please verify owners):
- Asha: compile prompt-level eval report + recommended guardrail list (due 2026-05-22). (linked_artifacts -> add eval sheet)
- John: run perf comparison (PR #142 branch vs main) across seq lengths (due 2026-05-18). Attach perf traces.
- Priya: confirm dedicated cluster headroom numbers and whether N-1 capacity guarantee possible during canary windows (due 2026-05-15).
- Maya: finalize Beta scope doc + customer-facing notes for AcmeHealth (due 2026-05-20).
- Raj (me): update roadmap doc with decisions + add rollout checklist template to Confluence (done after sync, due 2026-05-14).
- All: Review canary monitoring dashboard (link in Confluence) and flag any missing signals (by 2026-05-16).

Quick notes for follow-up thread (post-meeting):
- Capture exact acceptance metrics: p50 target, p95 target, error budget for streaming calls, quality regression threshold (e.g., <= 3% BLEU-like or eval delta).
- Add a small experiment to A/B compare quantized vs FP16 for a subset of prompts in Beta (Asha + John).
- If infra can't guarantee N-1, discuss temporary customer scoping: reduced concurrency or reserved capacity window for AcmeHealth during pilot.

My risks/concerns (for voice in meeting):
- We keep adding features without firm rollback/fallback paths in runtime — need a short playbook for quick rollback on quality/regression incidents.
- Evals currently lag by ~1 week vs release cadence; we should prioritize faster eval infra for canaries.

Notes-to-self / TODO before sync:
- Add links to Asha's eval sheet and perf dashboard in the Slack thread.
- Ping Priya for capacity numbers today (DM).
- Prepare one-slide visual showing tradeoffs (cost vs latency vs quality) for streaming+quantization to share.

End of notes. Will tidy after sync and push final decisions to roadmap doc.
